# Aura Wallet support

Use GitHub issues for reproducible application bugs and focused feature requests.
Use the project community link for general discussion.

Before posting, remove Bitcoin addresses, transaction details, device identifiers,
notification tokens, and all other personal data. Never share a recovery phrase,
private key, passphrase, wallet password, or signing key.

Security vulnerabilities must be submitted through
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/aurabitcoinwallet/aura-wallet/security/advisories/new),
not a public issue.
